# 💡 7th Capital
**concept** · first_person · knowledge

Behavioral sovereignty as personal wealth — your data, digital fabric, behavioral patterns, preferences, knowledge, social graphs. Its character is soil, not treasure: land-based rentier capital that yields rent by position, leased never conveyed, eroding on the adversary's background-information clock (C55 re-typed 2026-07-17; bridge C97).
